scholarship_exists.quote: Do you have scholarship for Undergraduate International Students? We do not offer scholarship to the Undergraduate International Students.
scholarship_exists.notes: UM's undergraduate international admission FAQ (Academic Services Department) states that UM offers no scholarship to undergraduate international students. The undergraduate financial-aid listing (https://aasd.um.edu.my/financial-aid-for-undergraduate, last update 14/10/2026) lists only government, state, corporate and loan schemes (PTPTN, PMG, Sabah PTPS, BAeK PTPTN, EcoWorld, AIA, RHB, MMC). Its one item for international students, the 'PTE x Universiti Malaya Scholarship 2026' (GBP 3,000 towards tuition, deadline 31 December 2026), links to pearsonpte.com: it is run by Pearson, the PTE test vendor, and is not an institutional or government award, so it does not count. The Malaysia International Scholarship (government) was not found on any um.edu.my page for undergraduates.
